title: Deep Learning-Based Joint Effusion Classification in Adult Knee Radiographs: A Multi-Center Prospective Study.
summary: The prospective multicenter radiograph cohort was evaluated against diagnostic labels; reported performance is confined to the study data and lacks independent clinical-outcome validation. The finding is bounded to the reported study and does not establish causal benefit or generalization.
